Sure! The whole project involves developing a modular AI assistant robot with physical movement and interactive communication, as well as an LLM-based interactive system. The system is designed to support natural language understanding, context-aware question answering, and dynamic presentation generation. Additionally, it includes features beyond basic obstacle detection and limited multilingual support, though the system is currently primarily developed for Vietnamese and English.
